summary: Leishen Energy Holding Co., Ltd., a Cayman-incorporated oil and gas equipment issuer listed on a US exchange, furnished a Form 6-K on September 14, 2026, reporting unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended March 31, 2026, plus related management discussion and analysis, as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory term is stated. The filing is a routine interim-results current report, incorporated by reference into the company's Form F-3 shelf; no special-situation or deal-risk arbitrage angle applies.
